title: Kononenkogroup header
description: A fixed, transparent header: a three-line wordmark top left whose last line is serif, and a comma-separated row of small links top right with an underline that draws in on hover. It inverts what is under it (blend: difference), so it is white on photos and black sections and black on paper. At the end of the page its lines rise out of their masks.
notes: the difference blend is exact on a white background theme; on tinted backgrounds the inverted colours tint too
in dark mode it uses plain foreground text instead of the blend
the rise-out at the page end is CSS scroll-driven (scroll(root)) and simply doesn't happen without support
name: kononenkogroup-header

props.name: wordmark
props.description: the wordmark, one line each; the last line is set in the serif

props.name: links
props.description: the links, written as one comma-separated line

props.name: separator
props.description: what follows every link but the last
